subject: Request to confirm outage window and potential SLA credit — BlueHarbor Payments
messages:
From: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra@blueharbor-payments.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: support@blueharbor-payments.com
Date: 2027-08-19T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Possible outage 2027-08-18 22:45-23:05 UTC — need confirmation and credit info

Hi Logan,

We saw a surge of 502/503 errors and elevated latency on our Redwood-backed payment routing yesterday evening. Traffic graphs show a clear spike starting ~2027-08-18 22:45 UTC and returning to baseline around 2027-08-18 23:05 UTC. Our customers experienced failed tokenizations and timeout errors for roughly 15–20 minutes.

Can you confirm Redwood's observed outage/downtime window for our account and advise whether this qualifies for an SLA credit? We need:
- Confirmed start/end time (UTC) you have recorded for any availability degradation against our dedicated pool.
- If eligible, an estimate of the credit calculation and next steps to receive it.

We can provide example logs if that helps. This impacted a handful of high-value transactions — we appreciate an expedited response.

Thanks,
Alejandra Ruiz
Head of Integrations
BlueHarbor Payments

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra@blueharbor-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T09:32:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Possible outage 2027-08-18 22:45-23:05 UTC — need confirmation and credit info

Hi Alejandra — thanks for raising this. I’ve looped in Marissa (support lead) and Rishi (billing) so we can confirm the window and outline credit eligibility.

Marissa — can SRE/ops verify the observed impact in the dedicated pool serving BlueHarbor and pull the raw connection/503 traces? If you prefer we can open an incident (INC-4521) and attach logs.

Rishi — once Marissa confirms the window can you provide the standard pro-rated credit calculation and expected timeline for applying it?

I’ll keep this high priority.

— Logan
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra@blueharbor-payments.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Possible outage 2027-08-18 22:45-23:05 UTC — need confirmation and credit info

Alejandra — we’ve started an internal evidence pull. Preliminary checks show error rate increase on the dedicated pool that serves BlueHarbor between 2027-08-18T22:46:00Z and 2027-08-18T23:02:00Z (UTC). I’m attaching the raw span logs and a condensed CSV of failed request counts for that window.

Quick notes / asks:
- Can you confirm which BlueHarbor API key(s) or route(s) saw failures so we can map to customer logs?
- I’ll follow up with a short RCF (request for confirmation) once SRE finishes the trace-level correlation.

Attachments: svc_logs_20270818_22-46_23-02.zip (traces + sampler)

Marissa Cole
Senior Support Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra@blueharbor-payments.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T10:24:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Possible outage 2027-08-18 22:45-23:05 UTC — need confirmation and credit info

Hi Alejandra — looping in on the billing side. Once Marissa confirms the official downtime window we’ll calculate the credit per the contract (monthly uptime SLA for dedicated pools). Typical calculation: pro-rated percentage of monthly committed spend during the affected minutes, capped per the SLA table.

If the confirmed window is ~16 minutes and BlueHarbor is on the standard Dedicated monthly commitment, we’d expect a small pro-rata credit (order of magnitude: single-digit percent of one day’s pro-rate). I’ll draft the exact credit amount after the confirmed timestamps.

For transparency I’ll also attach the invoice reference we’ll apply the credit against.

— Rishi
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra@blueharbor-payments.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T11:48:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Possible outage 2027-08-18 22:45-23:05 UTC — need confirmation and credit info

TL;DR — confirmed outage window and root-cause.

Hi all,
We investigated the traces and node telemetry. Root cause: an autoscaler config regression on the dedicated pool serving BlueHarbor triggered a rapid scale-down when background load dropped; a subset of inferencer replicas were evicted and then experienced cold-start connection errors leading to 502/503 responses while caches rehydrated.

Confirmed affected window (UTC): 2027-08-18T22:46:00Z -> 2027-08-18T23:02:00Z (16 minutes). Error rate peaked at ~14% of requests for your pool.

Actions taken:
- Reverted the problematic autoscaler change and pinned the pool config.
- Increased warm replica floor for the pool to reduce cold starts.
- Created INC-4521 for follow-up and a remediation checklist; engineering will prepare a postmortem draft.

Next steps for BlueHarbor:
- Logan/Marissa to confirm eligibility per contract and present proposed credit.
- We’ll deliver a postmortem draft within 5 business days and share technical artifacts (traces, kube events).

Evelyn Hart
Staff SRE, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Ruiz <alejandra@blueharbor-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T13:24:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Possible outage 2027-08-18 22:45-23:05 UTC — need confirmation and credit info

Alejandra — thanks for your patience and for providing the heads-up. Per engineering’s confirmed window (2027-08-18T22:46:00Z to 2027-08-18T23:02:00Z) and our SLA terms for your Dedicated pool we will be issuing a pro-rated credit. Rishi has proposed the credit calculation as follows:

- Affected minutes: 16 (0.011 days)
- Monthly committed spend: $48,000 (example reference for calculation only; Rishi will use actual invoice BH-2026-88)
- Pro-rated credit estimate: (16 / (30*24*60)) * monthly_commitment = ~0.037% of monthly commitment; billed credit will be the pro-rated dollar amount, subject to SLA cap.

Rishi will confirm the exact dollar figure and the invoice we will apply it to. We will also provide the incident postmortem and the attached logs (svc_logs_20270818_22-46_23-02.zip).

If BlueHarbor would like a formal SLA credit request document, Marissa and I can prepare and route it; otherwise I’ll proceed with Rishi’s billing flow and you should see the credit applied on the next billing cycle.

Alejandra — do you want the formal document routed now, or shall we proceed with the standard credit application?

— Logan
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
